{{Quote|The Codes from Kashyyyk will get us into the Holonet. But we need to encrypt the message. There's an old decryption module that might be just what we need.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Assault Team" />}}
The '''mission''' to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was the second step in the Rebellion's plan to keep the Empire away from Echo Base.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|If the Imperials follow their search plan, they'll find Echo Base in days. We need to send them on a wild goose chase.|Han Solo|<ref name="Assault Team" />}}
After stealing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|imperial]] plans [[Escape from the Devastator|escaping from the]] [[Devastator/Legends|Darth Vader's flagship]], [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] realized that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] will be able to trace their stolen plans to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. That is why [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] devised an plan to keep the Empire away from the [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden Rebel base]]. After protecting the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]] from an imperial attack, meeting with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and stealing the Imperial Codes from the [[Garrison/Legends|Imperial garrison]] stationed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Han, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewie]], [[R2-D2/Legends|Artoo]] and Luke made a hasty retreat of Kashyyyk and set course for Ord Mantell to meet with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and get an decryption module.

==The mission==
{{Quote|The Savrips may have the decryption module. I sent C-3PO in to make contact, but his team hasn't reported back.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Assault Team" />}}
Before the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived, Leia sent [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|rebel troopers]] to make contact with the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] and learn if they had the decryption module. The squad was ambushed by an imperial patrol and later attacked by a group of savrips. The savrips disassembled C-3PO and took it's parts to their lair.

After the ''Falcon'' landed and Han, Chewbacca, Artoo and Luke met with Leia, they decided to rescue Treepio. After saving the surviving rebels and collecting C-3PO's parts, the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] found the savrips' lair, where the protocol droid's torso was located. After repairing Treepio and making peace with the Mantellian Savrips, they found out from [[Unidentified Savrip Warmaker|the savrip chief]] the imperials had the decryption module.

After following Leia to the imperial outpost and defeating multiple squads of stormtroopers, the Heroes found the decryption module. However, on their way back to the ''Millennium Falcon'', they were stopped by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] and a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probots]]. After evading the trap and defeating the bounty hunters, the group of rebels escaped the planet in search for the only holoforger capable of encrypting the rebels' message.
